result.title: AI Design Hack Saves HOURS
result.description:
#ad I used @GensparkProduct Design to generate the UI for a FutureTools app... and it only took me about 30 minutes.

It created the home feed, individual tool pages, and a layered, fully editable design. I could even generate a launch video in the same visual style, share the project with my team, and bring it into Genspark Code to start turning it into a working product.

If you want to check out all their design templates, or start one from scratch, sign up and get free credits at the link in the pinned comment.

result.title: AI Made a Game I’d ACTUALLY Play
result.description:
Opus 5.5 might be the best coding model you can use right now.

I let it run my Megabonk game test for almost 20 HOURS… and the result is kind of insane.

It's also surprisingly affordable. Opus 5.5 is available on Claude’s Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans, so you can access it starting with the $20/month Pro plan.

If you’re using the API, it’s $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens.

That price-to-performance ratio is pretty wild for a model this good at long-running coding tasks.

Have you tried Opus 5.5 yet?

#ai #ainews #claude #anthropic #vibecoding

result.title: This AI Model Is INSANELY Fast & Cheap
result.description:
This AI model doesn’t use… WORDS?

It’s called Jev, from Typesafe AI, and instead of generating paragraphs or code text, it skips straight to making a decision.

Instead of text, it’s outputs are things like:→ a choice→ a score→ true/false

That makes it insanely fast and ridiculously cheap. Input costs start at just 4¢ per million tokens, and outputs are free because they’re apparently too cheap to meter.

Would you actually build with something like this?

#ai #ainews #futuretech #aimodel
